newsitem.title: USA: US 1996 oil/natgas well completions down 4 pct-API.
newsitem.headline: US 1996 oil/natgas well completions down 4 pct-API.

text.p: The estimated number of oil wells, natural gas wells and dry holes completed in the United States in 1996 fell 4 percent from the previous year, the American Petroleum Institute said Wednesday.
Completions have been falling at an annual rate of 7 percent over the previous five years, the API said.
A total of 20,904 oil and natural gas wells and dry holes was completed last year, compared with 21,768 in 1995.
Gas well completions were up 3 percent to 8,611, while oil well completions were down 11 percent to 7,338. Dry holes were down 4 percent to 4,955.

The API said exploratory drilling declined in 1996. There were 379 exploratory oil well completions, down 25 percent from the previous year; 444 gas well completions, down 13 percent; and 1,884 dry holes, down 10 percent.
